This surplus has been used to support the other FQHC services provided by SpringVale to qualified patients.  These dollars cover gaps in expenses not covered by service income generated or HRSA grant dollar in:
Primary Care
Rapid Care Medical (including radiology)
OBGYN
Dental Services 
Behavioral Health Services

The biggest reallocation of income from the pharmacy is in Rapid Care Medical and Dental Services.  These programs are vital to supporting our community but fall short of covering the 2025 cost of these services.  Pharmacy surplus has closed that gap in these services and the others listed above.

Pharmacy surplus also helped cover start up cost in opening our new location at Oxford Street.  This new location in providing the existing services and now Psych Med Management services under our FQHC certification.  These are all services that would not be successful as they are without the pharmacy surplus we are grateful for.
